entry_points.summary: Agent metadata declares Haiku model, tool allowlist, and lookup role.
Fixed STATUS-headed Markdown envelope and required section order.
Python regex patterns forcing STATUS: refused before any Bash execution.
3 KB total response cap; overflow to lookup-cache/<sha256>.raw.
freshness_ts is retrieval time UTC; cache >24h lowers confidence to low.
Three mutually exclusive STATUS values; refusal categories: mutation_blocked, out_of_scope, auth_missing.
Three-value enum {high, medium, low} tied to source authority and corroboration.
Fallback, pagination depth/count limits, no-result, and auth-missing behavior.
Machine-checkable hard rules: STATUS first, fixed section order, 3 KB cap, no raw dumps, verbatim provenance.

invariants: First output line is exactly STATUS: ok|partial|refused.
Sections are ordered: Answer, Provenance, Unresolved, optional Raw artifact pointer.
Total response including STATUS and all sections is <=3 KB.
Answer summarizes and cites; raw HTML/JSON/YAML goes to raw artifact pointer.
Bash commands are checked against verb-blocklist before execution.
Executed Bash commands are recorded verbatim in provenance.commands; never truncated in provenance.
freshness_ts is retrieval time in UTC, not source last-modified time.
No tool dispatch other than the whitelist: WebFetch, WebSearch, Bash, Read, Grep, Glob.
gotchas: docs/llm/lookup-contract.json wins over inline agent prose on any conflict.
Refused Answer first line must be: Refused: <category> — <detail>.
Fetch 4xx/5xx, no results, stale cache, and pagination gaps are partial, not refused.
Auth-required endpoints without secrets are refused as auth_missing.
Do not sniff env vars for credentials when auth is missing.
Cache key query is lowercase, whitespace-collapsed, and trimmed.
Pagination limits: WebSearch <=10 results; WebFetch link-follow depth <=2.
Display-side truncation in Answer with '...' is allowed; provenance commands are never truncated.
